messages:
nina: quick report: customer on CF Workers hit 'ReferenceError: Buffer is not defined' when using our SDK. stacktrace points to auth/hmac using node:crypto.
raj: probable bundler resolution to cjs. Workers are web runtimes: no Buffer, no node:crypto, no fs.
elaine: we should publish a proper edge build that uses WebCrypto and Web Streams. short-term we can offer a tiny shim.
nina: shim I tested: WebCrypto HMAC + polyfill for Buffer with Uint8Array wrapper — works but felt hacky.
raj: actionable plan: 1) add dist/edge/index.mjs with no node deps, 2) add package.json exports: './edge': { 'import': './dist/edge/index.mjs' } and prefer 'edge' cond; 3) edge d.ts replacing Buffer with Uint8Array and typesVersions mapping.
elaine: also convert any internal use of Node streams to Web ReadableStream in that build. set CI to run a Miniflare smoke test on PRs touching auth or exports.
ci-bot: CI job queued: edge-miniflare-smoke for branch nina/edge-shim at 2026-12-03T09:10:00Z.
nina: will put a runtime guard that errors with a clear message if node APIs are referenced in an edge runtime and point to the /edge import path in the message.
raj: docs: add troubleshooting header listing missing Node APIs and suggested tiny shims (HMAC, Buffer->Uint8Array) and example package.json snippet.
elaine: cool. i'll pick up the types mapping and miniflare test.
